services.name: Terry Tomalin Campground
services.desc: Check in: 1 p.m. Check out: 11 a.m.Quiet hours: 10 p.m. - 6 a.m.Firewood is available for purchase at the Hammock Hall Ranger Office The Terry Tomalin Campground is St. Petersburg's first public primitive family campground. The campground's name honors the late Terry Tomalin, a former Tampa Bay Times outdoors writer who supported Boyd Hill Nature Preserve through numerous service projects. The construction of this campground was part of a larger project to improve the visitor experience. The spacious campground boasts 18 campsites and 6 cabins and is open to both individuals and groups. The family campground offers access to a variety of outdoor activities for all ages and interests.
